questions.question_text: Wat is het totale bedrag dat de klant betaalt?
questions.explanation: With the student discount on one ticket, the total comes to twenty-six euros ('zesentwintig euro').

questions.question_text: Hoe laat gaat de zaal open?
questions.explanation: The employee says the hall ('zaal') opens at half past seven ('half acht'), before the show starts at 'kwart voor acht'.
